description: SOC2 Type II compliance overlay — append-only audit log, change-management surface, vendor attestation registry, incident response playbook. Composes onto fintech-ledger-backend / api-service / fullstack-ts.

buildHints.whenToUse: Bolt SOC2 Type II primitives (audit trail, change-management approvals, vendor registry) onto an existing backend before a Type II audit window opens.
firstSteps: Read `docs/SOC2-controls.md` — Trust Services Criteria CC1-CC9 mapped to files.
Wire `recordChange()` from `src/change-mgmt.ts` onto every deploy + config change — CC8.1 requires change approvals be logged.
Enforce CODEOWNERS + branch protection on main (CC7.2). The pack ships a reference `.github/CODEOWNERS` pattern.
Log into `docs/vendor-attestations.md` every sub-processor with a SOC2 attestation (Stripe, AWS, Vercel, etc.) — auditors check this.
Set up Uptime + response-time SLI dashboards — CC7.1 availability evidence.
gotchas: Audit log retention for SOC2 is commonly 12 months minimum; some auditors require 7 years. Confirm with your auditor before TTL'ing old rows.
Change management (CC8.1) requires ≥1 approver per change — self-merges are flagged. Enforce via branch protection, not honor system.
Vendor attestations must be CURRENT (within the audit window). A 2-year-old vendor SOC2 report is an exception finding.
Incident response (CC7.3) needs a tested playbook. Run at least one tabletop exercise before the audit.
architectureNotes: SOC2 audits are about process evidence, not code. This pack produces the artifacts (audit rows, CODEOWNERS, playbooks) auditors want to see. The controls themselves are operational.
